vehicleUpdates.headline: Related seven-seat test fits one rear-facing capsule plus two forward-facing restraints.
vehicleUpdates.summary: Original ST AWD is a seven-seat petrol car. A related T33 test demonstrates the mixed-direction three-across target; exact ST trim and your own seats remain unconfirmed. Keep row three folded for normal family use.

consumption.basis: Manufacturer ADR 81/02 combined claim for original 2.5 petrol AWD; not FWD 7.4 or e-POWER. Related ST-L AWD tests returned indicated 8.1 and 8.9 on different mixed routes.

observedConsumption.basis: CarExpert original 2023 ST-L AWD seven-seat mixed commuting/highway test, usually one occupant; related trim, not an exact ST test. CarsGuide separately reported 8.1 on its family mixed route. Not a fleet average.

vehicleUpdates.warranty: Original 5 years/unlimited km. Eligible cars can retain transferable Nissan service-activated cover up to 10 years/300,000 km. The advertised non-dealer re-entry deadline for 2021–24 retail cars was 31 December 2025; obtain written VIN status, not a seller promise.

familyFit.summary: The published seven-seat test matches one rear-facing plus two forward-facing restraints. ST grade and your exact models remain unconfirmed.
familyFit.row2: Two outboard ISOFIX positions; three top tethers. Centre tether is roof-mounted above row three. BabyDrive reports Nissan confirms no Outlander-style adjacent-seat occupancy restriction.
familyFit.row3: No ISOFIX or top tethers. ANCAP marks all tested child restraints not allowed here and does not recommend child-restraint installation. A reviewer using an untethered folding booster does not establish manufacturer approval.
familyFit.testedSeats: Achieve More and Momentum More forward-facing, Adapt More capsule rear-facing. This is a related seven-seat T33 test, not proof for any three seats.
familyFit.buckleAccess: Daily booster buckle access is unverified. ANCAP could not safely fit either sampled booster in the centre; both fitted individually outboard. One rear-facing convertible failed outboard ISOFIX but fitted belted.
familyFit.access: Wide doors help loading. With three row-two restraints, the reviewer removed one before entering row three. Adjust and secure seats according to the Australian manual; occupied-seat sliding is not verified.
familyFit.ventilation: Manufacturer confirms row-two console vents and manual air-conditioning in ST. No dedicated row-three vents; higher-trim climate control is not standard here.

pros: A related test demonstrates the required mixed-direction three-across layout.
Wide rear doors; 91-RON fuel, 17-inch tyres and temporary spare.
Lower used asking price than many hybrids; check the individual car.
cons: Centre boosters and one ISOFIX rear-facing convertible failed ANCAP installation checks.
No approved third-row restraint solution established; limited access with row-two seats fitted.
Original 10,000-km service interval; base ST omits ST-L cameras and comfort equipment.
inspection: Fit your rear-facing seat and the other two restraints together. Check front-seat clearance, independent buckle access, headrest position and roof-tether routing.
Verify 2.5 petrol AWD seven-seat, original MY23–MY25; exclude five-seat FWD, e-POWER and MY26 facelift when checking the ad.
Get written VIN warranty eligibility and transfer status. For non-Nissan service history, establish whether approved re-entry happened by 31 December 2025; later acceptance is discretionary.
Obtain the actual Australian owner manual and maintenance booklet. No period Australian fluid-change schedule or permission to move occupied restraint seats was publicly verified.
Test CVT/AWD cold and hot, inspect leaks and towing wear, and review diagnostic codes and service records. Older T32 and overseas turbo Rogue problems do not establish T33 2.5 failure rates.
Run Nissan recall/service-campaign VIN check. REC-006653 concerns e-POWER, not this petrol variant. ANCAP lists no third-row side-head airbag protection.
gaps: ST trim and your exact three-seat combination remain unconfirmed. Test uses a rear-facing capsule; a larger rear-facing convertible can need different clearance.
No current Australian period owner/maintenance PDF verified; check the car’s manual for installation, seat adjustment and fluid schedules.
No primary all-seven-up cargo litre figure found. Manufacturer 465 L is to the roof with row three folded, not VDA-to-seatback.
Only one fresh exact-configuration Queensland dealer ask remained available; excluded sold or unavailable cached cars.
No credible Australian T33 2.5 installed CVT replacement quote or annual failure-cost dataset found. Repair reserve remains uncertain savings.
Owner score is one complaint; it cannot estimate satisfaction or failure prevalence. MY26 facelift needs a separate entry.
Photo remains a labelled overseas e-POWER generation reference, not ST petrol.

priceUpdates.note: Two distinct available 2024 ST petrol AWD seven-seat dealer cars, U5828 and U5827. Both drive-away; median A$26,886. Narrow local sample with similar kilometres, not a full 2023–25 valuation. Sold Geely 2107551 and stale or mismatched ads are excluded. Dealer prose calls the transmission seven-speed, but its specification says Constant Variable; manufacturer CVT specification takes precedence.
priceUpdates.estimateBasis: Two dealer asking observations; not achieved prices or a mileage-adjusted market valuation.

observations.note: Stock U5827; VIN JN1T33JE5A0013802. Direct fresh read displays A$27,886 drive-away, 62,942 km and InStock schema. MY23 despite 2024 build listing; original pre-facelift ST AWD seven-seat. Confirm registration/duty inclusions.

Stock U5828, VIN JN1T33JEXA0013827, T33 MY25, seven seats, 2.5 petrol, 4WD/CVT; distinct from U5827 VIN ending13802. Current direct dealer page, no sold label observed. Conflicting generic seven-speed prose is not used as a specification.

ownershipUpdates.serviceBasis: A$650/year long-ownership planning allowance at 15,000 km, with A$450–950 sensitivity bounds. Historical related-ST-L AWD five-service prepay was A$2,124: A$424.80/visit × 1.5 visits/year ≈ A$637, rounded. This is not a current used-ST quote. A$399 flat-price first-five offer requires new retail from January 2025; original 10,000-km intervals still apply. Get the remaining VIN schedule and fluid-work quotes; tyres and unexpected repairs are separate.
warrantyCautions: Original five-year/unlimited-kilometre warranty is separate from service-activated years 6–10. Confirm original in-service date, eligible service history and current VIN coverage.

Nissan’s published re-entry deadline for non-dealer-serviced 2021–24 retail vehicles was 31 December 2025, now past. General terms permit discretionary written approval; a used-car purchase does not automatically reopen the offer.
Service-activated cover is transferable but excludes normal wear including suspension, mounts, hoses and exhaust components; 12-V battery and tyre cover differ. Confirm the applicable period booklet.
MY26 15,000-km service intervals and new-sale offers are not applied retrospectively to MY23–MY25.

fuelEstimate.basis: L/100km family-use planning point is the midpoint of two related ST-L AWD mixed-route indicated tests: CarsGuide 8.1 and CarExpert 8.9. Different routes and loads, not a measured ST fleet average. Official 7.8 remains separate; 7.8–11 are analyst sensitivity bounds.

risks.title: CVT and AWD repair exposure — price unverified
risks.detail: Both systems can create a substantial bill outside cover. No credible Australian installed T33 2.5-petrol replacement quote or failure frequency was verified. Inspect cold/hot operation, leaks and servicing. Older T32 or overseas 1.5-turbo Rogue evidence is not transferred to this engine/generation.
risks.priceBasis: Unpriced scenario; request a VIN-specific diagnosis and installed quote. The savings allowance is not an expected annual claim cost.
risks.warranty: A manufacturing defect may be covered if standard or service-activated warranty remains valid; wear and neglect are excluded.

risks.title: Age-related suspension — Australian workshop proxy
risks.detail: Generic conventional front damper-pair replacement is quoted at A$650–1,300 with labour by an Australian repairer. This is not a T33 quote or an incidence estimate.
risks.priceBasis: AUD installed generic front damper pair; alignment and additional components may cost extra.
risks.warranty: Normal wear can be excluded; ask Nissan to assess a manufacturing defect.

reviewUpdates.scope: ProductReview T33 ST seven-seat 4WD; one 2023-car owner complaint, not a representative survey.
reviewUpdates.summary: Exact-grade page reports 1.0/5 from one contribution about an unresolved vehicle fault and dealer response. No failure frequency follows from this. Broad T33 3.5/5 from 18 mixes e-POWER and petrol, so is not substituted. Tiny sample has very little scoring weight.
negativeThemes: One owner reports an unresolved fault and poor dispute handling; not independently diagnosed.

expertReviews.tested: 2023 Nissan X-Trail ST-L 2.5 petrol AWD seven-seat
expertReviews.scope: Related ST-L grade; different comfort equipment, tyres and cameras from ST. One family road test, not a reliability study.
expertReviews.verdict: Comfortable family SUV with useful handling and easy parking; row three takes boot room, and the CVT can feel jerky when pushed.
negativeThemes: Less cargo room with third row up

insuranceUpdates.basis: Rounded from Youi’s published A$1,181 X-Trail comprehensive mean; A$744–1,521 indicative range. Policies sold 22 November 2025–22 May 2026; model averages require at least ten policies, and 80% fell within or below the range. Mixed generations/powertrains, not an ST AWD Queensland quote. A$740–2,500 planning bounds are analyst assumptions. Replace with your quote; CTP is separate.

tyreUpdates.basis: Budget aftermarket fitted-set estimate, not a retailer quote. Underwood Brisbane lists Landspider Sportraxx 108V XL A$135 each / A$540 four on sale with fitting/balancing/disposal; Tyre City Tingalpa lists Dunlop 108W A$230 each / A$920 fitted. A$800 allows sale expiry and product/local variation. Confirm full GST-inclusive quote and four-tyre stock. No premium/OE branding assumed. Life is a common 40,000 km planning assumption (25,000–60,000 km sensitivity), not a measured model or tyre average. Wear varies with tyre choice, driving, maintenance and vehicle; model-specific replacement averages were not verified. Annual allowance = set budget × annual km ÷ 40,000, rounded to A$10. Age/damage can require earlier replacement. Alignment is additional; actual placard, wheel package and local fitted quote must be checked. Matching size/load/speed does not establish equal braking, efficiency or durability.

repairReserveUpdates.basis: A$800/year analyst repair-savings allowance, A$350–1,800 sensitivity bounds, for original T33 petrol AWD retained after warranty. No empirical Australian annual failure-cost dataset supports a precise ranking against Tesla or Outlander. Generic suspension pricing only illustrates one possible wear bill; no T32 or turbo Rogue CVT costs are transferred. Confirm remaining Nissan warranty eligibility. No e-POWER battery fund; tyres, scheduled service and insured crash costs are separate. Savings can remain unspent; this is not an observed or predicted annual repair bill.

fitAssessments.summary: Mixed-direction three-across is demonstrated in a seven-seat T33; grade unconfirmed, and a capsule may need less room than your rear-facing convertible.

arrangement.detail: Two named forward-facing restraints plus an Adapt More rear-facing capsule fitted across row two in BabyDrive’s seven-seat test. ANCAP separately restricts some centre restraints; check your models.

buckles.detail: No daily three-seat booster-buckle test. ANCAP’s two sampled boosters failed in the centre; harnessed-seat success does not establish booster access.

space.detail: Related mixed-layout test accommodated a 186-cm driver with the rear-facing capsule; third-row legroom remained limited. Larger rear-facing seats require a new check.

access.detail: Wide rear doors helped loading in the related test. Target fits row two; using row three with three restraints requires removing one. No approval for moving a seat with a restraint occupied was verified.

audit.summary: Mixed rear-facing/forward-facing fit is stronger than generic three-across labels. Exact ST owners remain a one-person sample; prices remain one fresh car. Warranty re-entry deadline and MY26 exclusions are explicit. Fuel budget now uses two related tests.

items.finding: Two distinct current Bundamba dealer 2024 ST petrol AWD seven-seat cars: A$25,886 / 61,219 km and A$27,886 / 62,942 km, both drive-away. Median A$26,886, n=2; narrow local cohort, low confidence as a broader valuation. Sold Geely 2107551 and stale or mismatched stock excluded.
Original 2.5 petrol AWD CVT seven-seat: 135 kW/244 Nm, 55-L tank, 91 RON, ADR 7.8 L/100km. Related road tests 8.1/8.9 inform an uncertain 8.5 budget; e-POWER figures excluded.

Related mixed-facing fit demonstrated, generous capsule clearance and wide doors. ST grade and household models pending; centre boosters and one outboard ISOFIX convertible fail ANCAP. Row three is not a restraint fallback.
Original five-year cover and conditional transferable years 6–10 distinguished. Non-dealer re-entry deadline for 2021–24 retail cars was 31 December 2025; obtain written VIN approval/status.

Retain A$650/year at 15,000 km using original 10,000-km interval and historical A$2,124 five-visit package. Current VIN prices/fluid schedule not verified; new-retail 2025 flat prices and MY26 interval excluded.
Retain A$1,180/year, rounded from Youi A$1,181 model mean. November 2025–May 2026 mixed-generation/powertrain national policies; not a Queensland ST household quote.

Budget aftermarket audit, 18 October 2026. 235/65R17 108V XL replacement reference: A$800 for four fitted. Common 40,000 km life is an illustrative assumption, not model-specific wear evidence. Prices and annual savings are estimates; check the real placard and local fitted quote.

Retain A$800/year uncertain savings, not observed failures. No installed T33 2.5 CVT quote/frequency found. Generic suspension example remains labelled; e-POWER battery recall excluded. Check VIN campaigns.
Exact ST seven-seat page: 1.0/5 from one complaint; very low evidence weight. Broad T33 aggregate mixes e-POWER. Added related ST-L CarsGuide 7.0/10 road test; no invented reliability rating.

ANCAP five stars, 2021 datestamp, through December 2027; 2,000-kg braked maximum subject to loaded limits. QLD four-cylinder rego/CTP A$864.50–880.50. Roof-height cargo basis and missing all-seven-up volume retained.
